name: source
description: Executes a SPICE netlist simulation and automatically loads the generated raw output files into the current database session.

name: run
description: Alternative syntax for source. Executes a SPICE netlist simulation.

name: help
description: Prints the built-in summary of all commands available in the interpreter.

name: exit
description: Terminates the interactive REPL session and exits the post-processor.

name: quit
description: Terminates the interactive REPL session and exits the post-processor.

name: q
description: Short alias for exit/quit. Terminates the REPL session.

name: load
description: Explicitly loads a SPICE raw file into the Waveform Database. Multiple files can be loaded; each is stored as a separate record.

name: db
description: Lists all datasets (records) currently loaded in memory. Shows the tag/name for each record.

name: records
description: Alternative name for db. Lists all datasets currently loaded in memory.

name: info
description: Prints metadata header of a specific record. If no tag is provided, defaults to the most recently loaded record. Shows Title, Date, Plotname, Type, Number of Points, and X-axis name.

name: list
description: Lists every signal variable stored within a record. Shows signal name, number of points, and marks the X-axis signal.

name: print
description: Outputs raw numerical values of one or more signals to the console in a formatted, aligned table.

name: export
description: Exports selected signals to a Comma-Separated Values (CSV) file. If no signals provided, exports all signals from the most recently loaded record.

name: plot
description: Generates visual graphs using the PlotEngine. First signal is the X-axis; subsequent signals are plotted on the Y-axis. Supports saving to PNG and custom titles.
example: plot time V(in) V(out) --title "Transient Response" --out response.png

name: meas max
description: Finds the absolute maximum value of a signal within an optional time window.

name: meas min
description: Finds the absolute minimum value of a signal within an optional time window.

name: meas ptp
description: Calculates the Peak-to-Peak difference (maximum value minus minimum value) of a signal.

name: meas avg
description: Calculates the arithmetic mean (average) of all data points in a signal.

name: meas mean
description: Alternative name for avg. Calculates the arithmetic mean of a signal.

name: meas rms
description: Calculates the Root Mean Square of a signal. Useful for power and AC equivalent calculations.

name: meas trise
description: Calculates the Rise Time — time difference between low and high percentage thresholds on the first rising edge. Defaults to 10%-90%.

name: meas tfall
description: Calculates the Fall Time on the first falling edge. Defaults to 90%-10%.

name: meas cross
description: Finds the exact X-axis value when a signal crosses a specific level. Can filter for rising or falling edges.

name: meas period
description: Calculates the time difference between two consecutive rising crossings of a specific level. Defaults to 50% midpoint if level omitted.

name: meas freq
description: Calculates the frequency of a signal as 1/period.

name: meas delay
description: Calculates the propagation delay between two signals by comparing their 50% crossing points.

name: meas find
description: Finds the exact value of one signal at the moment another signal equals a specified value. Uses interpolation for precise results.

name: calc
description: Evaluates complex mathematical expressions. Waveform results are saved back into the database as expr_1, expr_2, etc. Supports operators, element-wise functions, and reduction functions.

name: calc +
description: Addition operator. Can operate on two waveforms (index-by-index) or a waveform and a scalar.

name: calc -
description: Subtraction operator. Can operate on two waveforms or a waveform and a scalar.

name: calc *
description: Multiplication operator. Supports waveform-waveform and waveform-scalar operations.

name: calc /
description: Division operator. Supports waveform-waveform and waveform-scalar operations.

name: calc abs
description: Element-wise absolute value function. Returns a new waveform where each point is the absolute value of the input.

name: calc sqrt
description: Element-wise square root function.

name: calc db
description: Converts a signal to decibels using 20 * log10(|x|). Useful for Bode plot magnitude.

name: calc log
description: Element-wise base-10 logarithm.

name: calc ln
description: Element-wise natural logarithm (base-e).

name: calc exp
description: Element-wise exponential function (e^x).

name: calc neg
description: Element-wise negation (-x).

name: calc sin
description: Element-wise sine trigonometric function.

name: calc cos
description: Element-wise cosine trigonometric function.

name: calc tan
description: Element-wise tangent trigonometric function.

name: calc max
description: Reduction function that finds the maximum value of a waveform, collapsing it to a scalar.

name: calc min
description: Reduction function that finds the minimum value of a waveform, collapsing it to a scalar.

name: calc avg
description: Reduction function that calculates the average value of a waveform, collapsing it to a scalar.

name: calc mean
description: Alternative name for avg reduction function.

name: calc rms
description: Reduction function that calculates the Root Mean Square of a waveform, collapsing it to a scalar.
